related_issues.reason: Also about uv behaviour when the project directory and the cache directory overlap (UV_CACHE_DIR inside the project), the same area as the new project-inside-cache check.

rationale: The reporter gives the exact error ('The project directory `.` is inside the cache directory'), the uv version (0.11.21), and the change that caused it (#19659, they say), and says it worked before. The wheel is built from an sdist unpacked under ~/.cache/uv/sdists-v9, so a build hook that runs `uv export` there trips the new guard. That is a regression for a plausible workflow, though the guard may be intentional and a maintainer could treat this as by-design or a question. Searches found no duplicate; #15227 is related context only. I did not read the docs and did not look up #19659 itself, so that link is unchecked.
